findings.text: follow-on: the local write now happens after push_tree returns, so a failure inside write_released_version (rather than the push) -- a full filesystem, or the os.stat(bundle) racing a concurrently-removed descriptor -- leaves the registry holding a version the local descriptor does not name, until the next pull. This is the mirror of the defect the node repaired and is the lower-risk direction (an unpublished local version cannot be pulled by a facility), so it is a note rather than a defect. Still open from the prior review.

info: os.chmod(tmp_name, os.stat(bundle).st_mode) passes the full st_mode, including the file-type bits (S_IFREG, 0o100000), to os.chmod. Linux ignores the bits above the file permission bits so the pinned 0644 test passes, but the intent is the permission bits and os.stat(bundle).st_mode & 0o7777 (or stat.S_IMODE(...)) is the portable form.
